note_en: 套 is the measure word for things that come as a complete set, and it's the standard one for apartments and houses: 中介带他看了三套房子 "the agent showed him three apartments," and once the noun is clear it can stand alone: 一套靠近地铁站，一套靠近学校 "one near the subway, one near a school." English just says "one," but Chinese keeps the measure word even when the noun is dropped.
